title: Cliff face Wang autotiling — edge-entity system + cliff-grass / cliff-stone biomes with sub-variants
intent: S173 (variable cell height) renders cliff side faces as plain flat BoxGeometry faces — no autotiling, no biome context, no variation. The arena reads as a stack of identical grey slabs. This story adds a dedicated cliff-face rendering pipeline: detect cliff edges from the heightmap, spawn one entity per cliff edge, resolve a 4-variant (2-bit) Wang bitmask per edge strip, and render biome-aware procedural mesh geometry. Two biomes ship: cliff-grass (earthy soil body + grass lip overhang at top) and cliff-stone (angular faceted rock, no overhang). Each biome has 2 sub-variants for visual variety. Corner caps fill gaps where perpendicular cliff faces meet. Result: cliff walls read as distinct terrain features, not BoxGeometry artefacts.
rationale: Source: tile-edge-library-design.md §8 (architecture decision) and terrain-design.md §2.2 (cliff rules). GDP-2026-06-03-001 (grass rewrite) establishes the overlay pattern; this story applies the same philosophy to the VERTICAL dimension. Cliffs are the most visually prominent terrain feature in height-delta arenas — plain BoxGeometry sides undermine every height-differentiated map. Ships after GDP-2026-06-03-001 proves the sub-variant + procedural mesh pipeline so cliff-face can reuse the engine extension.
acceptanceHints: READ FIRST: `docs/game-design/tile-edge-library-design.md` §8 (cliff face concept), `docs/game-design/terrain-design.md` §2.2 (cliff gameplay rules already shipped).
A. ECS ARCHITECTURE — three new project-local systems
A1. CliffFace component (project-local schema fragment, kaboom-crew/src/schemas/cliff-face.ts):
{ direction: 'N' | 'E' | 'S' | 'W', gx: number, gz: number, delta: number, topBiome: 'cliff-grass' | 'cliff-stone' }
`gx`/`gz` = coordinates of the TALLER cell. `delta` = integer height difference (≥ 1).
`direction` = which face of the taller cell this entity represents.
(N = taller cell's north face, toward gz-1 lower cell; E = east face toward gx+1 lower cell; etc.)
A2. CliffFaceSpawnerSystem (runs once on world load / world swap):
- Query Heightmap singleton via engine/grid/height-query.ts.
- Walk every pair of cardinal-adjacent cells (gx,gz) + (gx+dx, gz+dz).
- When heightOf(A) > heightOf(B): spawn a CliffFace entity for the A-side face.
- Assign direction: A→B is (dx=0,dz=-1)→N; (dx=1,dz=0)→E; (dx=0,dz=1)→S; (dx=-1,dz=0)→W.
- Determine topBiome from A's FloorTerrain/WangTileFamilyMember family name:
grass → 'cliff-grass'; stone/path/dirt → 'cliff-stone'; default → 'cliff-grass'.
- Give each entity: CliffFace + Transform (position = edge midpoint, see §B) + MeshRenderer (mesh='').
- Idempotent: clear previous CliffFace entities on world swap before re-scanning.
A3. CliffFaceWangResolverSystem (runs each frame, dirty-checking CliffFace entities):
- For each CliffFace entity, compute 2-bit bitmask:
bit 0 (LEFT):  another CliffFace entity exists to the LEFT of this strip position at the same direction + height level.
bit 1 (RIGHT): same for RIGHT.
LEFT/RIGHT definition from the outward-facing perspective of the cliff (looking from taller cell toward lower cell):
N-face strip: LEFT = (gx-1, gz) N-face; RIGHT = (gx+1, gz) N-face.
E-face strip: LEFT = (gx, gz-1) E-face; RIGHT = (gx, gz+1) E-face.
S-face strip: LEFT = (gx+1, gz) S-face; RIGHT = (gx-1, gz) S-face.
W-face strip: LEFT = (gx, gz+1) W-face; RIGHT = (gx, gz-1) W-face.
Result: variantIndex 0 (isolated), 1 (left-connected), 2 (right-connected), 3 (corridor).
- Sub-variant: deterministic per (gx, gz, direction, sceneSeed): hash % 2.
- Write meshKey = 'procedural:kaboom-cliff-{topBiome}-{variantIndex}-{subVariant}' to MeshRenderer.mesh.
- Only update MeshRenderer when bitmask or subVariant changes (dirty flag).
A4. Corner cap detection (inside CliffFaceSpawnerSystem):
- After all cliff face entities are spawned, scan every cell corner (gx+0.5, gz+0.5 world-space).
- A corner needs a CAP when exactly 2 perpendicular cliff faces share that corner (e.g., N-face at (gx,gz) + E-face at (gx,gz)).
- Spawn a CornerCap entity at that corner: small wedge mesh, biome = taller cell's biome, no Wang bitmask needed.
- CornerCap mesh key: 'procedural:kaboom-cliff-{topBiome}-corner'.
B. TRANSFORM / POSITIONING
World-space position of a cliff face entity (CELL_SIZE = 1.0):
N-face at cell (gx,gz): position = (gx, cellHeight * 0.5, gz - 0.5). Rotation Y = 0° (faces -Z).
E-face at cell (gx,gz): position = (gx + 0.5, cellHeight * 0.5, gz). Rotation Y = 90°.
S-face at cell (gx,gz): position = (gx, cellHeight * 0.5, gz + 0.5). Rotation Y = 180°.
W-face at cell (gx,gz): position = (gx - 0.5, cellHeight * 0.5, gz). Rotation Y = 270°.
Height in the formula above = heightOf(gx,gz) (the taller cell). `cellHeight = delta * CELL_HEIGHT_UNIT`.
Mesh is built in local space: width 1.0 cell (X axis), height `delta` cells (Y axis, centered at Y=0), depth ~0.2 cells (Z axis, outward).
C. GEOMETRY RECIPE — cliff-grass biome
Builder function signature: buildCliffGrassVariant(variantIndex: 0|1|2|3, subVariant: 0|1, delta: number): BufferGeometry
Build in local coordinates. Cliff face is H = delta cells tall, W = 1.0 cell wide.
Outward direction = +Z (before Transform rotation).
C1. GRASS LIP (top 0.12 cells):
- Horizontal shelf that overhangs 0.12 cells in +Z (outward, toward lower cell).
- Top surface: subdivided 4×2 grid for blade-noise Y displacement (same as GDP-2026-06-03-001 grass).
- Y displacement: bladeNoise(x, z) ∈ 0..0.05 (deterministic per vertex position + delta + subVariant seed).
- Outer edge of lip slopes down 0.04 cells (Y at outer edge = topY - 0.04).
- Vertex colours: GRASS_PRIMARY (#4a8a3e) base → GRASS_HIGHLIGHT (#5fa84a) at outer lip edge tips.
C2. CLIFF BODY (middle 80% of height, below the lip):
Subdivide into 6 horizontal bands × 4 vertical columns (24 quads). Per-band vertex colour:
Band 0 (top): CLIFF_SOIL_LIGHT (#7a5c3a) blends with GRASS_PRIMARY.
Bands 1-2:    CLIFF_SOIL_LIGHT (#7a5c3a).
Band 3:       CLIFF_SOIL_MID   (#5a3e22).
Bands 4-5:    CLIFF_SOIL_DARK  (#3a2810) blending toward base.
Outward convexity / sub-variant:
Sub-variant 0 (smooth): one gentle Bezier bulge, peak +0.05 cells in +Z at 45% height.
Sub-variant 1 (layered): two horizontal step-ledges at 33% and 66% height marks,
each ledge extends +0.03 cells in +Z, drops 0.02 cells in Y.
Gives a sedimentary-strata look.
Variant caps (variantIndex 0/1/2/3 determines left/right end treatment):
Isolated end (no neighbor): taper the column's outer Z by 0.06 cells across the outermost 0.15 cells of width.
Connected end (neighbor present): flush vertical edge, no taper. Matches neighboring face perfectly.
Apply to left end when bit 0 = 0 (no left neighbor), right end when bit 1 = 0 (no right neighbor).
C3. BASE UNDERCUT (bottom 8% of height):
- Tapers inward: bottom edge pulls 0.05 cells in -Z (UNDER the higher cell).
- Creates visual weight / grounding for the cliff.
- Vertex colour: CLIFF_SOIL_DARK (#3a2810).
D. GEOMETRY RECIPE — cliff-stone biome
Builder function signature: buildCliffStoneVariant(variantIndex: 0|1|2|3, subVariant: 0|1, delta: number): BufferGeometry
D1. NO GRASS LIP — top edge is flush with cell boundary (Y = topY, Z = 0).
Hard beveled edge: top row of vertices has a 0.02 cell bevel in Z for visual crispness.
Top vertex colour: STONE_LIGHT (#8a8a7a).
D2. CLIFF BODY — subdivide into 4 horizontal bands × 6 vertical columns:
Band colours:
Top 20%:    STONE_LIGHT (#8a8a7a).
Mid-top 30%: STONE_MID  (#6a6a5a).
Mid-bot 30%: STONE_MID  (#6a6a5a) → darker blend.
Bottom 20%: STONE_DARK  (#4a4a3a).
Sub-variant 0 (regular panels):
4 vertical score lines across the face (subdivisions every 0.25 cells width).
Minimal outward convexity: +0.02 cells peak at 50% height.
Score line vertices: STONE_MID tint (slightly darker than surrounding).
Sub-variant 1 (crevice):
Same panel structure PLUS 1 horizontal crevice at 45% height:
Width: 0.6 cells centred on face (starts at 0.2, ends at 0.8 of face width).
Depth: 0.07 cells in -Z (inward cut).
Height: 0.08 cells tall.
Crevice interior face colour: STONE_SHADOW (#2a2a1a).
Position of crevice deterministic per (gx, gz, direction): hash(gx*31+gz*7+dirIndex) offset ±0.1.
Variant caps: same left/right taper rule as cliff-grass (§C2 last bullet).
Taper amount: 0.04 cells (slightly less than grass — stone is more geometric).
D3. BASE FLARE (bottom 8% of height):
- Slight outward flare: bottom edge extends +0.04 cells in +Z.
- Visual 'foundation' anchoring the cliff to the floor.
- Vertex colour: STONE_DARK (#4a4a3a).
E. CORNER CAP MESH
Corner cap fills the triangular gap at convex corners (two perpendicular cliff faces meeting).
Shape: thin triangular prism, XZ cross-section = right-isosceles triangle with legs 0.12 cells.
Height = same delta as the surrounding cliff faces.
Biome colours: same palette as surrounding cliff (smooth sub-variant only, no crevice).
Vertex colours match the surrounding body colour at same Y level.
Mesh key: 'procedural:kaboom-cliff-{topBiome}-corner'.
Only convex corners need caps (taller cell has two perpendicular cliff faces outward).
Concave corners (inner corners) have no gap — no cap needed.
F. MESH REGISTRATION
Register in kaboom-crew/src/register-cliff-builders.ts (new file, parallel to register-block-builders.ts):
4 variants × 2 sub-variants × 2 biomes = 16 cliff face meshes.
2 corner cap meshes (one per biome).
Total: 18 procedural mesh registrations.
Mesh keys follow pattern: 'procedural:kaboom-cliff-{biome}-{variantIndex}-{subVariant}'
e.g. 'procedural:kaboom-cliff-cliff-grass-3-0' (corridor, sub-variant smooth)
'procedural:kaboom-cliff-cliff-stone-0-1' (isolated, sub-variant crevice)
Corner cap keys: 'procedural:kaboom-cliff-cliff-grass-corner', 'procedural:kaboom-cliff-cliff-stone-corner'
Each builder receives delta as a runtime param — use the ProceduralMeshRegistry builder signature that passes
per-entity seed/params (the same pattern GDP-2026-06-03-001 uses for grass sub-variant hash).
G. PERFORMANCE TARGETS
Cliff face mesh: ~120 vertices each (6 bands × 4 cols = 24 quads × 4 verts = 96 + lip + base ≈ 120).
Corner cap mesh: ~30 vertices each.
Cache size: 16 × ~120 + 2 × ~30 = 1980 cached vertices total. Negligible.
Runtime: at 60 cliff edges in a complex arena: 60 × 120 = 7200 vertices. Well within budget.
CliffFaceSpawnerSystem: runs once per world load. O(gridW × gridH × 4) = O(N). Fine.
CliffFaceWangResolverSystem: dirty-checked per entity, same pattern as WangTileResolverSystem.
H. TESTS
buildCliffGrassVariant(0, 0, 1): returns geometry with > 80 vertices (body + lip + base).
buildCliffGrassVariant(3, 0, 1): variant 3 (corridor) has no tapered ends — outermost left/right columns are flush.
buildCliffGrassVariant(0, 0, 2): delta=2 → geometry height is twice delta=1 (boundingBox.max.y - min.y ≈ 2.0).
buildCliffStoneVariant(1, 1, 1): variant 1, sub-variant 1 — geometry includes crevice (inward-Z vertices at 45% height).
buildCliffGrassVariant(0, 0, 1) != buildCliffGrassVariant(0, 1, 1): different sub-variant → different vertex positions.
Sub-variant determinism: same (gx, gz, direction, seed) always picks same sub-variant index.
Bitmask: two adjacent N-face CliffFace entities at (5,3) and (6,3) — resolver gives variantIndex=1 to (5,3) RIGHT-connected and variantIndex=2 to (6,3) LEFT-connected.
Corner cap: arena with NW convex corner (taller cell at NW) spawns exactly 1 CornerCap entity at that corner.
I. VISUAL QA
Load a height-varied arena (e.g. S173 demo or pitfall arena from S143):
Cliff walls read as earthy soil + grass lip (cliff-grass) or angular rock (cliff-stone) — NOT grey box sides.
Long cliff strip (5+ connected faces): no visible seam between adjacent face meshes.
Strip end cells (isolated/end variants): taper naturally, no hard rectangular edge.
Convex corners: no triangular gap between perpendicular cliff faces.
Different cells in same strip with same variantIndex: sub-variant 0 vs 1 visibly different mesh profile.
Height delta=2 cliff: body is proportionally taller (2× height), same biome colours.
J. OUT OF SCOPE
Cliff-path / cliff-dirt as separate biomes (cliff-stone covers them adequately).
Animated cliff effects (falling dirt, crumbling).
Cliff faces that respond to soft-block destruction (cliff geometry is static heightmap).
Wall-shadow Wang layer near cliffs — separate story (GDP-2026-06-03-004 in roadmap).
Cliff collision mesh for physics — gameplay cliff blocking already handled by GridOccupancySystem height check (S173).
